name: party-invitation
description: A themed party invitation with RSVP, a guest-list admin page and email notifications. Runs on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.dev: npm run build:fast && wrangler d1 migrations apply party-rsvps --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.demo.jsonc
